xBRIEFInfo.description: Story xBRIEF for GitHub issue #2814 — PR-anchored review-owner lease replaces local review-monitor.json.

plan.title: feat(review-cycle): PR-anchored review-owner lease replaces local review-monitor.json

narratives.Description: Machine-local `.deft/review-monitor.json` cannot serialize review-cycle ownership across clones, so two maintainer agents can both babysit the same PR (as with #2810). This story makes a sticky PR issue-comment with `<!-- deft:review-owner -->` markers the sole lease source of truth: register/release/verify speak only to GitHub over REST, stop writing the local ledger, and update review-cycle skill + commands pointers so agents cannot claim a monitor is active without a successful GitHub claim.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Replace file IO in `packages/core/src/review-monitor/record.ts` and `verify.ts` with sticky-comment parse/render plus REST list/create/patch helpers (fixture-friendly; preserve exit `0`/`1`/`2`), and stop all writes to `.deft/review-monitor.json`. 2. Wire CLI `packages/cli/src/review-monitor-register.ts` and `verify-review-monitor.ts` (plus `tasks/review-monitor.yml`) for claim conflict, create-race oldest-wins, expiry takeover, `--force`, and new `review-monitor:release`, with focused tests under `packages/core/src/review-monitor/*.test.ts` and CLI register/verify tests. 3. Update `content/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md`, `content/commands.md`, and `content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md` so register must succeed before a second review-cycle/fix loop and legacy local JSON alone cannot satisfy `verify:review-monitor`.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive maintainer running review-cycle across machines, I want a PR-anchored review-owner lease on GitHub, so that two agents cannot both claim the same PR's fix loop.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Replace the machine-local `.deft/review-monitor.json` ledger (#2655) with a **PR-anchored review-owner lease** as the sole source of truth.

Dogfood: PR #2810 cross-maintainer double babysit. Prior gate: #2655. Related: #1880 Gap C, #2797, #2308.

### Verb semantics
- `review-monitor:register` — claim sticky comment; conflict / race / renew / expiry / `--force`
- `review-monitor:release` — end lease
- `verify:review-monitor` — GitHub lease only; local JSON must not satisfy
narratives.Labels: bug, enhancement, swarm, determinism, agent-experience, review-cycle, monitoring

items.title: Given no active lease on PR N, when register runs, then it creates/edits the sticky review-owner comment and does not write local JSON.

narrative.Acceptance: Given PR N has no active `<!-- deft:review-owner -->` lease, when `review-monitor:register` runs, then it creates or edits the sticky claim comment with owner, monitor_agent_id, head_sha, started_at, and expires_at, and it does not write `.deft/review-monitor.json`.

items.title: Given an unexpired lease for another owner, when a second register or create-race loser runs, then it exits conflict without overwriting the winner.

narrative.Acceptance: Given an unexpired GitHub lease for a different owner or monitor_agent_id, when a second register runs (including a create-race loser after two near-simultaneous creates), then the command exits conflict (`1`), does not overwrite the oldest winning claim, and removes its duplicate comment when safe.

items.title: Given an expired lease, when register runs without --force, then takeover succeeds; non-expired steal requires --force.

narrative.Acceptance: Given an expired sticky lease, when register runs without `--force`, then takeover edits the claim in place and succeeds; given a non-expired foreign lease, takeover without `--force` refuses and with `--force` succeeds while surfacing the prior owner.

items.title: Given an active lease, when release then verify run, then the lease ends and verify requires GitHub not local JSON.

narrative.Acceptance: Given an active GitHub lease, when `review-monitor:release` runs, then a subsequent register by another owner succeeds; when `verify:review-monitor` runs, then exit `0` requires an unexpired GitHub claim and presence of legacy local JSON alone does not satisfy the gate.

items.title: Given skill and commands pointers, when agents enter review-cycle ownership, then they must register on GitHub before claiming a monitor is active.

narrative.Acceptance: Given updated review-cycle skill, commands.md, and agent-prompt-preamble pointers, when an agent starts a second review-cycle or fix loop, then the docs require a successful GitHub `register` first and document that `.deft/review-monitor.json` is obsolete and ignored.

expected_outputs: register/release/verify no longer depend on local JSON
